subject: Future Tech
title: Nano and Artificial Intelligence
description: A 60-second lesson on Nano and Artificial Intelligence.

hook.text: AI needs computing power. Nanotech provides it.

discovery.text: Memristors—nanoscale components that remember their state—act like artificial synapses.

twist.text: The brain uses 20 watts. Today's GPU clusters use megawatts to match a fraction of its capacity.

climax.text: Intel's Loihi 2 chip uses nano-transistors arranged as 1 million artificial neurons.

punchline.text: Smarter AI needs smaller components. Nano meets neural.

quiz.question: What is a memristor?
options: A nanoscale component that acts like an artificial synapse
